direction: Follow-up parameter neighborhood for daily close-channel entries with a Wilder ATR ratcheting close-trailing exit.
hypothesis: The prior E=20/40 ATR channel grid produced low trade counts on reused OOS history. Predeclare shorter E=5/10/15-day entry channels with varied Wilder ATR periods and stop multiples to test whether the same volatility-scaled trend exit offers more repeated trades; this is an exploratory second-stage screen on the same reused OOS, not independent validation.

source.citation: TA-Lib official ATR implementation and documented Wilder recursion.
source.scope: Defines the indicator only; no profitability claim.

rule.entry: On closed UTC daily bar j, enter if close[j] > max(high[j-E:j]); current signal day excluded from prior channel. Next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open is the execution reference.
rule.atr: TR=max(H-L,abs(H-prev_close),abs(L-prev_close)); seed ATR with the arithmetic mean of first N complete TR values (indices 1..N); subsequent ATR=((N-1)*prior_ATR+TR)/N. ATR is computed causally and continuously, never reset by fold.
rule.stop: At entry signal freeze ATR_entry and peak_close=signal close; initial stop=peak_close-M*ATR_entry. For each later closed daily close, peak_close=max(previous_peak,close[j]); stop=max(previous_stop,peak_close-M*ATR_entry). Exit on close[j]<=stop, execute next UTC day 00:01. Close-confirmed only; no intraday stop guarantee.
rule.account: Each variant uses its own 2,000 USDT single-asset spot account; all capital allocated to its specified asset; long-only, no leverage, short, borrowing, add-on, transfers or interest. Do not re-enter on the exit signal day. Terminal OOS liquidation is fixed and costed.

followup_reference.reason: Most favorable prior E=40 ATR configurations had only 2–3 completed round trips; all 36 variants were rejected by fold/robustness/round-trip gates. This batch changes E, N and includes new configurations; it reuses the same historical interval and is not a fresh holdout.

time_boundaries.walk_forward: 12 consecutive, non-overlapping 30-day evaluation folds; continuous positions and indicator state; no fitting or fold reset.
time_boundaries.history_note: Repeated development/validation interval, not an untouched final test set.

costs.impact: 0.5 × sample stdev of previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns × sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote ADV)
costs.exchange_filters: Fresh public GET exchangeInfo snapshot, derived PRICE_FILTER/LOT_SIZE/NOTIONAL/PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE, adverse tick rounding, lot floor, 5-minute pre-execution VWAP proxy. Historical L2 and historical exchange filters unavailable.

sensitivity.neighbor: Same asset; adjacent grid indices on all three axes, bounded at edges; report local 3× positivity, no OOS winner selection.

failure_gates.multiple_testing: Accumulated trial count and reused OOS invalidate untouched holdout claims; no DSR/PBO is claimed.

data.format: Archived Binance spot 1m OHLCV aggregated to complete UTC daily OHLC/quote volume.
